Current Atlas semantics do not select one convention even though PlotIntents use NIR for both program-target and usable-buffer questions. candidates.human_gate: Semantic layer must choose or separate NIR conventions before source mapping.

candidates.reason: Official debt files provide authoritative stock and maturity information, but the current CanonicalIndicator is a monthly rolling next-12-month public-sector FX-service measure. Producing it requires unresolved perimeter, currency, capital/interest, creditor, valuation, exclusion, windowing and revision choices. No declared DerivedIndicator currently constructs this measure.
candidates.human_gate: Declare the exact debt-service perimeter and construction before any capture or provider adapter work.
